title: Marriages
summary: He met his first wife in Florida, married her in 1935, and remarried after her death.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: And, the other thing is we had sort of just taken the musical and career life and separated it completely from Erskine the man in that sense. But, you've been mentioning, you know, just in passing, 'my wife' and things like that. Can you take us back, you know, to the, wherever, 'Bama State or wherever it was and give us some idea of how, you know, it evolved in terms of your getting married and things like that?
Well, my first wife. I met her in Florida. I was at 'Bama State then and we used to tour Florida for the school. And, she was, she was out of school She had finished.

Bethune, she went to Bethune-Cookman College. And, at the time when I met her, I was going to a show and she was cashier during that summer and I met her. Then, I invited her to a dance, you know, just to meet her. So, she came, and we got to be friends then. And then, that summer, she happened had a vacation and came to New York. That was on her vacation before going back to teaching. So, she found out, she decided that she didn't want to go back. So, we finally got married. That was in '35. I think I was 21 years old then.

So, we married. She passed about 5 years ago. And then, I remarried. This lady, she's from Philadelphia. She loves sports. We did a lot of bowling and everything. We live over in Jersey now, down in Willingboro,

So, things have been, during that part, things have been very nice. The only thing was after losing my first wife, then I had to find someone else that was wonderful to me, you know, and went along with her family. Yeah. So, that made things at home, feel
good at home. I have her, she made a home for me. Although I'm up here all the time, but when I go there, everything's so nice. But, she comes up here and spends quite a bit of time with me.
